adjudication.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, the job does `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)`. If `i.content` is `nil` for a feed item (common for feeds without `content:encoded`), calling `scrub` will raise `NoMethodError`, aborting the whole poll run since there is no rescue around the loop. The diff also explicitly sets `sidekiq_options retry: false`, so failures won’t be retried by Sidekiq. Additionally, `i.title` is passed through to `TopicEmbed.import(user, url, i.title, content)` without guarding against `nil`, which can lead to creating/updating topics with a nil title depending on downstream behavior. These issues are directly evidenced by the new code paths in this diff.
